name: Delixy Holdings Limited Ordinary Shares
summary: Delixy Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company that specializes in the large-scale commercial exchange of crude oil and various refined petroleum products. Its operational footprint spans across Southeast Asia, East Asia, and the Middle East. This firm, established in 2024, maintains its principal office in Singapore. Ultimately, Delixy Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Mega Origin Holdings Limited.
